headline.en: Middle Market Debt Weekly: ABL Capacity Holds Firm as Fed Raises Rates, Private Credit Defaults Climb
headline.zh: 中间市场债务周报：美联储加息、私人信贷违约上升之际，ABL容量保持坚挺

summary.en: ABF Journal's Middle Market Debt Weekly reported that asset-based lending capacity held firm while the Federal Reserve raised rates and private credit defaults climbed.
summary.zh: ABF Journal的《中间市场债务周报》报道，在美联储加息、私人信贷违约上升之际，资产支持贷款（ABL）容量保持坚挺。
